# GymGear

> An online store for gym equipment and lifting apparel: lever belts, lifting
> straps, knee sleeves and wrist wraps. Visitors can browse and filter the
> catalogue, read and write product reviews, keep a wishlist, and place orders.

The site is available in English and Georgian. Language is chosen per visitor and
does not change the URL, so every page below serves both.

**Note for automated readers:** this is a client-side rendered single-page app.
The HTML at every URL is the same near-empty shell, and the content is built by
JavaScript in the browser. If you do not execute JavaScript you will see no page
content. The `<title>` and description in the shell describe the site as a whole,
not the individual page you requested.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://gym-app-7y5y.vercel.app/dashboard/main): featured and
  best-selling products, categories, brand story, and customer reviews.
- [Shop](https://gym-app-7y5y.vercel.app/dashboard/products): the full catalogue,
  with text search, category filters, a price-range filter, and sorting by price
  or name.
- [About](https://gym-app-7y5y.vercel.app/dashboard/about): who makes the gear,
  the standards it is held to, and the guarantee.
- [Cart](https://gym-app-7y5y.vercel.app/dashboard/cartPage): the visitor's
  basket and order summary. Placing an order requires an account.

## Products

Individual products live at `/dashboard/productDetail/<id>`, where `<id>` is a
numeric product id. Each page has images, price, description, an average star
rating, and customer reviews. Product ids are not enumerable from a static file;
reach these pages by following links from the Shop page.

## Not for indexing

These require signing in or contain personal data, and are marked `noindex`:
`/dashboard/profilePage`, `/dashboard/orders/<id>`, `/auth/signIn`,
`/auth/register`.
